name: Rustea Conversation
source: A short, cute game to warm up your day. You can try to get all the possible dialogue if you're a completionist, or just read one or two branches if you'd prefer. Either way, it's just meant to be a fast, light-read.
translation: 一款可爱的小品游戏，为你的一天添些暖意。如果喜欢全收集，可以尝试读完所有可能的对话。如果更喜欢随意体验，也可以只看一两条分支。无论如何，本作都旨在提供一次简短、轻松的阅读。
